welcome.title: Welcome to TPA
welcome.subtitle: Trains, Planes and Automobiles (and Boats)
lines: Watch the UK's planes, trains and buses on the move, with the traffic on the roads around them. Free for everyone, always: no adverts, no subscriptions.

sections.heading: What to expect
items: Every bus, train and plane is drawn from real, official location reports, and placed as accurately as the data allows.
Buses follow their actual routes, stop by stop.
Tap any bus to see where it's come from, where it's heading and its next stop.
Zoom in on a street to see where the traffic is held up.

smallPrint: TPA is for interest only. Positions can be late, missing or wrong, so please don't rely on it for travel plans or anything safety-related; check with your operator.

Your privacy: no accounts, no cookies, no adverts and no tracking. TPA doesn't record who you are or where you are; your browser only remembers small settings, like having seen this screen. The street map loads from OpenFreeMap, which sets no cookies.
If you email us, we only use your message to reply. Get in touch: enquiries@tpalive.co.uk

Built from open data: Department for Transport (bus locations, timetables and stops), Transport for London (bus fleet), Network Rail, FlyItalyADSB, ADSB.lol, OpenStreetMap and TomTom. Full details under Data sources & credits.
Test version: anything marked MOCK is a pretend example · © 2026 Rob Burnett

credits.text: Made by Rob Burnett, a Yorkshireman who once said "wouldn't it be good if you could see all the trains, planes and buses at once?" and then, unlike most people, didn't stop. Head of Quality Control: Geoff the cat, who has inspected every vehicle on TPA, mostly by lying on the keyboard. His findings to date: "zzzzzzzzzz". Get in touch: enquiries@tpalive.co.uk
Map © OpenFreeMap · © OpenMapTiles · © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). The street map loads straight from OpenFreeMap, which sees your internet address as any website would and sets no cookies.

Bus data sourced via the Department for Transport's Bus Open Data Service (BODS) (Open Government Licence). Stops: NaPTAN, DfT (OGL). Roads: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL, via Geofabrik); backup: contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2026 (OGL). London bus types: TfL's bus fleet list, Powered by TfL Open Data. Positions between reports are estimated.

Contains information of Network Rail Infrastructure Limited licensed under the Network Rail Infrastructure Limited Data Feeds Licence. Lines: Network Rail track model (OGL). Stations: NaPTAN, DfT (OGL). Place codes: YA TIPLOC list (Network Rail OGL, Rail Delivery Group CC BY 2.0 UK, CC BY-SA 4.0 sources). Platforms: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Positions between reports are estimated.

Aircraft positions from FlyItalyADSB (CC BY-SA 4.0), with ADSB.lol (Open Database License) as a backup. Airline, aircraft and route details: Virtual Radar Server standing data (CC0), with thanks. Between reports, positions are estimated from speed and direction.

Live departure and arrival boards: Powered by National Rail Enquiries, through the Rail Data Marketplace. Station list and positions © David Wheatley, Trainline EU and their sources (Open Database Licence).

Bus stops: NaPTAN, Department for Transport (Open Government Licence). Bus stop departure and arrival times: BODS timetables, Department for Transport (Open Government Licence); live "due" times are worked out by TPA from BODS bus positions.

Bus and coach stations and their stands: NaPTAN, Department for Transport (Open Government Licence). Departure and arrival times: BODS timetables, Department for Transport (Open Government Licence); live "due" times are worked out by TPA from BODS bus positions.
TPA's own pictures and icons, made for TPA by Rob Burnett. No logos or company colours.
Barlow fonts (SIL Open Font Licence), Leaflet (BSD-2-Clause) and MapLibre GL JS (BSD-3-Clause).

Recorded sounds in Kids mode come from the AltSFX sound set by ALEXbr (CC BY 3.0), made from freesound.org and bigsoundbank.com recordings by kyles, UncleSigmund, Joseph Sardin, gadzooks (CC BY 3.0), eliasheuninck (CC BY 3.0), polymorpheva, Yoyodaman234, qubodup and cliftonmcarlson (the rest CC0).
